title: Explicit multicast membership and readiness
summary: Membership is a first-class object whose lifetime is independent of a listener, and NORM exposes native readiness through the common provider contract.
invariants: join() creates a SocketMulticastMembership and listenerOn() attaches without owning that membership; only explicit leave tears down an explicitly owned membership.
Interface and SSM source remain structured membership state; NormSetSSM applies to the receiver membership, not to a sender configuration.
NormGetDescriptor is projected through provider-neutral descriptor/waitReady/tryAccept delegation; NORM does not create a competing event framework.
Event Runtime may schedule the exposed descriptor later while NORM continues to own protocol event draining.
